grammar_focus: KS5/29/53 一般过去时 / 现在完成时 / 现在完成进行时 三时态对比(教材 L77 Key structures,方案B换情节包):过去某时完成用一般过去(was built/appeared/discovered)、影响持续到现在用现在完成(has stood/have crossed/has remained/has been repaired)、持续动作强调过程用现在完成进行(have been examining/have been working);辅以时间状语 for(时段)/ since(时间点)/ ago(时段+ago)
scene: 专家们已经对镇上最老的桥考察了六个月。这座桥建于1850年,170多年前。从那时起它就横跨在河上,成千上万的人从上面走过。最近,古老的石头上出现了裂缝,于是市里决定仔细研究它。专家们发现,最初的桥有一部分是木制的。“我们从去年春天起一直在研究它,”一位专家说,“我们已经了解了很多关于它当初是怎么建造的。”木制部分很久以前就被换成了石头,但设计几个世纪以来一直没变。这座桥修过很多次,但它看起来几乎和1850年时一样。如今它仍是镇上最古老的建筑之一——好几代人都喜爱它。

grammar_card.title: KS5/29/53 一般过去 / 现在完成 / 现在完成进行 + for/since/ago
grammar_card.intro: 本课对比三种时态:①一般过去时——过去某个时间点完成的事(The bridge was built in 1850);②现在完成时——过去发生、影响或状态延续到现在(It has stood here since 1850);③现在完成进行时——从过去一直做到现在、强调过程(Experts have been examining it for six months)。时间词:for + 一段时间(for six months);since + 时间点(since 1850);一段时间 + ago(170 years ago)。

rows: It has stood over the river since 1850.
现在完成进行(强调过程)
Experts have been examining it for six months.
for + 时段 / since + 时间点

specialRules.rule: 美语里“人行道”说 sidewalk(英式 pavement)、“市中心”说 downtown(英式 city centre);本课已按美语写。
for 接“一段时间”(for six months);since 接“时间点/起点”(since 1850);“一段时间 + ago”表示“多久以前”(170 years ago)。三者别混。

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — How long have experts been examining the bridge?

passage: Experts have been examining the oldest bridge in our town for six months. The bridge was built in 1850, more than 170 years ago. It has stood over the river since then, and thousands of people have crossed it. Recently, cracks appeared in the old stone, so the city decided to study it carefully. The experts discovered that the original bridge was partly wooden. "We have been working on this since last spring," one expert said. "We have learned a lot about how it was made." The wooden parts were replaced with stone long ago, but the design has remained the same for centuries. The bridge has been repaired many times, yet it still looks almost the same as it did in 1850. Today it remains one of the oldest structures in town — and people have loved it for generations.
